text: Locked in a custody battle over their five-year-old daughter Candice, Frank Carveth grows wary of Dr. Hal Raglan, whose therapy asks patients to [turn suppressed emotion into changes in their bodies|origin|a mind turning on itself]. As Raglan intensifies his sessions with Frank's wife Nola, the people she resents are bludgeoned by [small, deformed dwarf-children|threat|dangerous children] with no navels. [Candice watches her grandmother die|who_suffers|young children] in the kitchen, and the brood gather in an attic around [a mother whose rage gives birth|images|babies, birth and pregnancy].
